CLOSED. Landed as Gerrit change 1878 -> merged to origin/main at d8fac8981b (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 on patchset 2; all 4 pytest jobs green incl. macos-latest py3.13). The patchset-1 macOS Verified-1 was confirmed a pre-existing gate-snapshot rename race under xdist (unrelated subsystem), not this change -- it did not recur on patchset 2.

Close-gate housekeeping: added src/rebar/_cli/help/transition.txt and src/rebar/_io/import_ndjson.py to file_impact (10 paths total); that material edit invalidated the prior signed plan-review, so re-ran review-plan (PASS, no blocking; advisory only) which re-certified at d8fac898. Completion-verify gate then passed. Closing unblocked scratchy-leprous-galago (1128-505b-54ac-497f) and churlish-fruited-dassie (fd48-7a80-33e9-4400).

Import safety-net note (from advisory fix #2): origin/main's transition_compute(force=True) on an open->closed target was a no-op (start-work bypass N/A for a close; close gate keyed on the then-unset force_close), so reverting the ndjson import path to a plain non-forcing close preserves exact prior behavior rather than introducing a new completion-gate bypass.
